scope.statement: Exact all-m full-tube counting proof for the seed-66 hexagonal contact fan at three specified rational translations, with independent finite geometric replay.
scope.domain: Proof: every integer m>=2 at v=(1/1000,2/1000),(1/50,1/25),(1/100,2/25). Replay: m=2,...,12 at these three phases plus m=32 at the first phase; nine primitive tubes and 441 independent rational distance comparisons.
scope.limitations: Unreviewed proof candidate and finite evidence. No all-phase/rotation/joint-averaged-surplus/straight-crosscut claim; no source j_*, global response extraction, triangle-free source, Level I closure or canonical promotion. Predecessor proves nonglobality for m>=32.

result: Raw tube bound Xi-|T_Z|=6-3m, actual right deficiency=6m+3 and tube rank-cut slack=9m-3; retain 2m globally neighborless collar rows and one additionally isolated sink. At these phases, |T_Z| exceeds the Section-175 mean-cost upper bound for every m>=7, so that averaged estimate cannot be used pointwise.
remaining_questions: Independent AI audit of the all-m interval argument and exact source-pinned package.
Extract source-specific Xi>=j_*+|T_Z| for an actual canonical source, or construct a full-cardinality strict-diameter competitor.
